# BLO-47526 — narrow the data mount for shared-isolation runs

`src/server/job-manifest.ts`, `src/server/job-manifest.test.ts`.

The runtime-descriptor `shared` branch of `resolveJobIsolation` used to return
`SHARED_JOB_ISOLATION` (`enabled: false`). That kept the whole `/paperclip` PVC
mounted read-write, so a shared-mode pod could rewrite the server-read
`/paperclip/.mcp.json` and every company's instruction bundles (residual of
BLO-32734 Phase 2a).

It now returns `enabled: true` with agent-scoped persistent roots under
`instances/default/data/k8s-isolation/<co>/<agent>/<key>/`. `workspaceRoot` is the
handed project checkout (falling back to `<root>/workspace` only when nothing is
handed or the handed cwd is the data root). With isolation enabled,
`narrowWritableSurface` holds and `/paperclip` is mounted read-only.

Tests: two cases on the runtime-descriptor `shared` branch; reverting the branch
alone turns 3 tests red.
